comment.text: Label of the left sidebar section that lists end-to-end encrypted private rooms, placed next to the Rooms and Forms sections and holding an Archive sub-item. It names the section, that is the private rooms as a group, not a property of one item: use a short plural or section-name form, like the Rooms and Forms labels, not an adjective agreeing with a single noun.
